description: Get a snapshot of the authenticated user's current life context (identity, today/upcoming events, pulse, trackers, plus a question-aware facts slice with trace). Relationships and memories are included by default; pass include_*=false to omit. social_edges is capped at the highest-confidence 40 — check social_edges_truncated / social_edges_total. Location is opt-in. Requires an authenticated Dayze account via OAuth; scoped API keys are also supported for direct clients. ($0.15; API key required)

include_location.description: Include city/country label; never returns a precise address

include_memories.description: Include recent memory summaries (default true; set false to omit)

include_relationships.description: Include inner-circle and relationship summaries (default true; set false to omit)

query.description: Optional question. Drives the question-aware facts slice (family, names, dates, merchants) returned in facts/trace.

name: get_life_context

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

facts.description: Question-aware personal facts, in selection order.

items.description: One personal fact chosen for the question. Same ids as Dayze chat.

id.description: Table-qualified record id, e.g. people:<uuid> or events:<id>.

source_label.description: Where the fact came from, e.g. "from Contacts".

state.description: current, planned, completed, stale (age_label set) or disputed.

tier.description: entity, join, static, dynamic or vector.

items.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

omitted.description: Facts left out, counted by reason.

partial.description: True when the facts slice is incomplete; never read a missing fact as "none on file".

redaction.description: pii redacted|raw; sensitive_topics the caller may receive; counts of sensitive trackers / memories withheld.

sections.description: sections.harness: ok, or error (HARNESS_FAILED / HARNESS_DEGRADED with failed_sources) when facts may be missing.

social_edges_total.description: person_connections rows on file; null when unknown.

social_edges_truncated.description: True when more edges exist than social_edges lists.

trace.description: Which facts were supplied and why. fact_ids equals facts[].id.

title: Life Context Snapshot
